title: [3.0.0.1-dev-i] Error in BG Check value when transferred from AAPS into NSClient
body:
When giving "BG Check" value in AAPS, it is transferred also into NightScout and NSClient app but
BG value is shown wrongly in NSClient app. The value in NSClient is the right BG value divided by 18.

This was tested with the latest 3.0.0.1-dev-i but the problem has been also in previous dev releases.
I am not sure is this a problem in NS or AAPS/NSClient.

I use mmol/L in all places (AAPS, NS, NSClirent).
